title: Account Executive, AI Sales
description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The AI team is focused on one of Stripe’s most strategic growth areas: enabling the monetization and scaling of AI-native and AI-enabled businesses. We’re in a unique position – partnering with the world’s most ambitious AI companies (the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, etc) building on the frontier of artificial intelligence -- across infrastructure, foundation models, agents, and applications -- to help them grow and commercialize globally using Stripe’s full financial stack.

As part of Stripe’s GTM / Sales organization, this team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to shape Stripe’s AI GTM strategy and ensure that the world’s leading AI companies -- from early-stage innovators to the largest public players -- choose Stripe as their monetization platform.

What you’ll do

  • Work with existing Stripe customers in the AI Industry to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue
  • Own the full sales cycle, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close
  • Develop account plans and cross sell into your list of strategic AI customers, driving growth through expansion and new revenue streams
  • Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business, deeply understanding problems they are solving and helping drive to solutions
  • Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture

Minimum requirements

  • * 8+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
    • 4+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required
    • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
    • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
    • A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
    • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
    • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
    • Superior verbal and written communication skills
    • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
    • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to public sector organisations across Spain. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic agreements with central government ministries, regional and local administrations, and public agencies. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the public sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to public sector stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in citizen services, administration, and research. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with public sector decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help public institutions obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the public sector in Spain. Navigate complex public institutions to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to public procurement cycles and budgeting processes, including tenders, framework agreements, and partner or resale routes, to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse public sector landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within ministries, agencies, and administrative departments. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for public sector applications
  • Navigate complex public sector stakeholder ecosystems including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Lead conversations with customers on data sovereignty, security, and compliance, working with Security, Legal, and Product colleagues on how we meet those requirements
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from public sector users and conveying public sector needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for public institutions
  • Continuously refine the public sector sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 7+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies, including selling to public sector organisations in Spain
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within public institutions and securing strategic agreements by understanding both technical requirements and public sector use cases
  • Practical command of Spanish public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies, and partner or resale routes
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate public sector organisational structures, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, and IT departments
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various public sector audiences, from technical teams to senior officials
  • Deep understanding of public sector buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including data sovereignty, security, and compliance requirements
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the public sector market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for use by public institutions

Nice to have: familiarity with the security and compliance frameworks that apply to technology purchasing in the Spanish public sector.

Acerca del puesto

Como Enterprise Account Executive en Anthropic, te incorporarás al equipo fundacional que está a la vanguardia de la introducción de nuestra API de productividad con IA de última generación y de nuestras soluciones SaaS en las organizaciones del sector público en España. Impulsarás la adopción de una IA de vanguardia y segura mediante acuerdos estratégicos con ministerios de la Administración General del Estado, administraciones autonómicas y locales y organismos públicos. Pondrás tu experiencia en venta consultiva en el sector público al servicio del crecimiento de los ingresos y te convertirás en un socio de confianza para los interlocutores del sector, ayudándoles a integrar y desplegar la IA y a descubrir todo su potencial en los servicios a la ciudadanía, la administración y la investigación. En colaboración con los equipos de GTM, Producto y Marketing, perfeccionarás de forma continua nuestra propuesta de valor, nuestra metodología de ventas y nuestro posicionamiento para que conecten con quienes toman las decisiones en el sector público.

El perfil ideal siente pasión por desarrollar nuevos segmentos de mercado, identificar oportunidades de alto potencial y ejecutar las estrategias que permiten aprovecharlas. Al impulsar el despliegue de los productos emergentes de Anthropic, ayudarás a las instituciones públicas a adquirir nuevas capacidades y contribuirás al desarrollo ético de la IA.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conseguir nuevos clientes y generar ingresos para Anthropic en el sector público en España. Orientarte en instituciones públicas complejas para llegar a las personas clave en la toma de decisiones, darles a conocer nuestros servicios y ayudarles a tener éxito con Anthropic. Serás responsable de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta el cierre.
  • Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias comerciales innovadoras adaptadas a los ciclos de contratación pública y a los procesos presupuestarios, incluidas las licitaciones, los acuerdos marco y las vías de venta a través de partners o revendedores, para alcanzar y superar los objetivos de ingresos. Analizar el panorama, las tendencias y la dinámica del sector público para convertir los planes estratégicos en acciones y campañas comerciales específicas.
  • Liderar la expansión en el mercado identificando nuevos casos de uso en ministerios, organismos y departamentos administrativos. Colaborar de forma transversal para diferenciar nuestra oferta en las aplicaciones del sector público.
  • Desenvolverte en ecosistemas complejos de interlocutores del sector público (altos cargos, responsables de transformación digital y tecnología, departamentos de TI y órganos de contratación) para generar consenso.
  • Liderar las conversaciones con los clientes sobre soberanía del dato, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo, trabajando con los equipos de Seguridad, Legal y Producto en la forma en que respondemos a esos requisitos.
  • Contribuir a la hoja de ruta y a las funcionalidades del producto recogiendo las opiniones de las personas usuarias del sector público y trasladando sus necesidades. Aportar ideas que refuercen nuestra propuesta de valor para las instituciones públicas.
  • Perfeccionar de forma continua la metodología de ventas para el sector público incorporando lo aprendido a playbooks, plantillas y buenas prácticas. Identificar mejoras de proceso que optimicen la productividad y la coherencia comerciales.

Este puesto puede encajar contigo si tienes:

  • Al menos 7 años de experiencia en ventas B2B (SaaS, soluciones API o tecnologías emergentes), incluida la venta a organizaciones del sector público en España
  • Una trayectoria demostrada en la gestión de ciclos de venta complejos en instituciones públicas y en el cierre de acuerdos estratégicos, basada en la comprensión tanto de los requisitos técnicos como de los casos de uso del sector público
  • Un dominio práctico de la contratación pública española: licitaciones, acuerdos marco, centrales de compras y vías de venta a través de partners o revendedores
  • Capacidad demostrada para desenvolverte en las estructuras organizativas del sector público y generar consenso entre interlocutores diversos, entre ellos altos cargos, responsables de transformación digital y tecnología y departamentos de TI
  • Experiencia contrastada superando objetivos de ingresos gracias a una gestión eficaz de un pipeline y un proceso de venta en constante evolución
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y soltura para presentar ante públicos diversos del sector público, desde equipos técnicos hasta altos cargos
  • Un conocimiento profundo de los ciclos de compra, los procesos de decisión y los principales retos del sector público, incluidos los requisitos de soberanía del dato, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo
  • Un enfoque estratégico y analítico del mercado del sector público, combinado con una ejecución táctica y creativa para aprovechar las oportunidades
  • Nivel bilingüe de español e inglés, con una excelente comunicación oral y escrita en ambos idiomas
  • Pasión por los sistemas avanzados de IA y sus aplicaciones, o experiencia con ellos. Te importa de verdad que los sistemas de IA de vanguardia se desarrollen de forma segura y ética para su uso por parte de las instituciones públicas.

Se valorará: familiaridad con los marcos de seguridad y cumplimiento normativo aplicables a la contratación de tecnología en el sector público español.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to public sector organisations across Italy. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic agreements with central government ministries, regional and local administrations, and public agencies. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the public sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to public sector stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in citizen services, administration, and research. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with public sector decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help public institutions obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the public sector in Italy. Navigate complex public institutions to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to public procurement cycles and budgeting processes, including tenders, framework agreements, and partner or resale routes, to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse public sector landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within ministries, agencies, and administrative departments. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for public sector applications
  • Navigate complex public sector stakeholder ecosystems including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Lead conversations with customers on data sovereignty, security, and compliance, working with Security, Legal, and Product colleagues on how we meet those requirements
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from public sector users and conveying public sector needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for public institutions
  • Continuously refine the public sector sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 7+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies, including selling to public sector organisations in Italy
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within public institutions and securing strategic agreements by understanding both technical requirements and public sector use cases
  • Practical command of Italian public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies, and partner or resale routes
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate public sector organisational structures, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, and IT departments
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various public sector audiences, from technical teams to senior officials
  • Deep understanding of public sector buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including data sovereignty, security, and compliance requirements
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the public sector market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • Bilingual proficiency in Italian and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for use by public institutions

Nice to have: familiarity with the security and compliance frameworks that apply to technology purchasing in the Italian public sector.

Il ruolo

In qualità di Enterprise Account Executive in Anthropic, entrerai a far parte del team fondatore impegnato in prima linea nel portare la nostra API di produttività basata su IA all'avanguardia e le nostre soluzioni SaaS alle organizzazioni del settore pubblico in Italia. Promuoverai l'adozione di un'IA di frontiera e sicura concludendo accordi strategici con ministeri e amministrazioni centrali, amministrazioni regionali e locali ed enti pubblici. Metterai la tua esperienza di vendita consulenziale nel settore pubblico al servizio della crescita dei ricavi, diventando un partner di fiducia per gli interlocutori del settore e aiutandoli a integrare e adottare l'IA e a scoprirne tutte le potenzialità nei servizi ai cittadini, nell'amministrazione e nella ricerca. In collaborazione con i team GTM, Prodotto e Marketing, perfezionerai costantemente la nostra proposta di valore, la nostra metodologia di vendita e il nostro posizionamento, perché siano rilevanti per chi prende le decisioni nel settore pubblico.

Il profilo ideale ha la passione per lo sviluppo di nuovi segmenti di mercato, per l'individuazione delle opportunità ad alto potenziale e per l'attuazione delle strategie necessarie a coglierle. Favorendo la diffusione dei prodotti emergenti di Anthropic, aiuterai le istituzioni pubbliche ad acquisire nuove capacità, contribuendo al tempo stesso allo sviluppo etico dell'IA.

Responsabilità:

  • Acquisire nuovi clienti e generare ricavi per Anthropic nel settore pubblico in Italia. Orientarti all'interno di istituzioni pubbliche complesse per raggiungere le figure decisionali chiave, far conoscere i nostri servizi e aiutarle ad avere successo con Anthropic. Sarai responsabile dell'intero ciclo di vendita, dal primo contatto alla chiusura.
  • Definire e attuare strategie di vendita innovative, adatte ai cicli degli appalti pubblici e ai processi di bilancio, comprese gare, accordi quadro e canali di vendita tramite partner o rivenditori, per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di fatturato. Analizzare lo scenario, le tendenze e le dinamiche del settore pubblico per tradurre i piani strategici in attività e campagne commerciali mirate.
  • Guidare l'espansione sul mercato individuando nuovi casi d'uso all'interno di ministeri, enti e uffici amministrativi. Collaborare in modo trasversale per differenziare la nostra offerta per le applicazioni del settore pubblico.
  • Muoverti in ecosistemi complessi di interlocutori del settore pubblico (dirigenti apicali, responsabili della trasformazione digitale e della tecnologia, direzioni IT e uffici acquisti) per costruire consenso.
  • Guidare il confronto con i clienti su sovranità dei dati, sicurezza e conformità normativa, lavorando con i team Sicurezza, Legale e Prodotto sul modo in cui rispondiamo a questi requisiti.
  • Contribuire alla roadmap e alle funzionalità di prodotto raccogliendo il feedback di chi utilizza le nostre soluzioni nel settore pubblico e portandone all'interno le esigenze. Fornire indicazioni che rafforzino la nostra proposta di valore per le istituzioni pubbliche.
  • Perfezionare costantemente la metodologia di vendita per il settore pubblico, integrando quanto appreso in playbook, modelli e buone pratiche. Individuare miglioramenti di processo che ottimizzino la produttività e la coerenza commerciale.

Potresti essere la persona giusta se hai:

  • Almeno 7 anni di esperienza nella vendita B2B (SaaS, soluzioni API o tecnologie emergenti), compresa la vendita a organizzazioni del settore pubblico in Italia
  • Una comprovata esperienza nella gestione di cicli di vendita complessi all'interno di istituzioni pubbliche e nella conclusione di accordi strategici, fondata sulla comprensione sia dei requisiti tecnici sia dei casi d'uso del settore pubblico
  • Una padronanza concreta degli appalti pubblici italiani: gare, accordi quadro, centrali di committenza e canali di vendita tramite partner o rivenditori
  • Una capacità dimostrata di muoverti nelle strutture organizzative del settore pubblico, costruendo consenso tra interlocutori diversi, tra cui dirigenti apicali, responsabili della trasformazione digitale e della tecnologia e direzioni IT
  • Un'esperienza comprovata nel superare gli obiettivi di fatturato grazie a una gestione efficace di una pipeline e di un processo di vendita in continua evoluzione
  • Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e la sicurezza necessaria per presentare a interlocutori diversi del settore pubblico, dai team tecnici ai dirigenti apicali
  • Una conoscenza approfondita dei cicli di acquisto, dei processi decisionali e delle principali criticità del settore pubblico, compresi i requisiti di sovranità dei dati, sicurezza e conformità normativa
  • Un approccio strategico e analitico al mercato del settore pubblico, unito a un'esecuzione tattica e creativa per cogliere le opportunità
  • Padronanza dell'italiano e dell'inglese a livello bilingue, con un'eccellente comunicazione scritta e orale in entrambe le lingue
  • Passione per i sistemi di IA avanzati e le loro applicazioni, o esperienza diretta con essi. Ti sta a cuore che i sistemi di IA di frontiera siano sviluppati in modo sicuro ed etico per l'uso da parte delle istituzioni pubbliche.

Costituisce titolo preferenziale: familiarità con i quadri di sicurezza e conformità normativa applicabili agli acquisti di tecnologia nel settore pubblico italiano.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise (São Paulo, Brazil)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing expansion opportunities with a defined list of top-tier Enterprise customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key C-level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners throughout Figma.

This is a full-time role based in our São Paulo hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage a defined list of named strategic accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen C-level relationships for every account in your book
  • Align with executives on business challenges and gain sponsorship for enterprise wide deployments for a suite of products, identifying where Figma’s roadmap and innovations fit in the long term
  • Conduct thorough analysis to create strategic account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at a senior level to build on expansion opportunities
  • Co-create with cross-functional partners to expertly position Figma, drive deals forward and ensure customer success
  • Leverage opportunities to advance executive level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with Enterprise customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives
  • Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business
  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (9 months+)
  • Proficiency in a sales methodology and process that creates value for customers
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish and English (written and spoken) is required for this Latin America-focused role

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling solutions to technical audiences at the highest level in Engineering, Product and Design teams
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment
  • Certified in deal qualification and prospect discovery
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
